summary: Frontend E2E testing completed on preview URL. All 8 requested flows work end-to-end: (1) /connexion → 'Mot de passe oublié ?' link navigates to /mot-de-passe-oublie and submitting an email shows neutral forgot-sent confirmation. (2) Registration at /inscription redirects to /compte; verify-email-banner + resend-verification-button + account-points-card (0 pts) present; change-password succeeds and user stays logged in. (3) Account delete flow: submit disabled until 'SUPPRIMER' typed → deletion logs user out and re-login with old creds fails with 'Invalid email or password'. (4) /compte/points shows loyalty-total/earned/promo, rewards-empty, ledger-empty and transfer-needs-verification because email is unverified. (5) Admin login → admin-tab-loyalty → /admin/fidelite: switches present, created reward appears in list, points adjustment for a customer succeeds (toast 'Nouveau solde : 250 pts') and customer /compte/points then shows total=250, promo=250. (6) Simulation checkout (30 UC pack → /commande → MVola + phone → pay-button) transitions to payment-success in ~10s; /suivi/<order>?pubg_id=... shows status-paid. (7) After forcing payments.expires_at to the past in Mongo, /suivi shows status-expired and retry-payment-button; clicking retry creates a new attempt (status-pending_payment) and payment-deadline text 'Paiement possible jusqu'à HH:MM (15 min)' appears. (8) Header wordmark 'MagicGameStore' rendered, theme-toggle present, bottom-nav testids present, floating-chat-button present. Only console errors observed are 401 on /auth/me for anonymous pages (expected).
